programme.desc: Poncon Theatre Visiting a theatre in an Oklahoma boom town gone bust, where eerie happenings take centre stage; seeing why strange events still get people talking, then join witnesses as they revisit.
programme.title: Paranormal Evidence: You Can't Deny it

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Nine of Swords To unearth long-buried memories, Joni and Jay conduct a séance.
programme.title: Playing Gracie Darling

programme.desc: S02 E18 — Birdzilla & New Montauk Monster An unidentified creature washed up on the beach; an object is seen over the skies of Inner Mongolia; Tony Harris and his team of experts examine new videos and photographs to reach a verdict on what's behind strange happenings.
programme.title: The Proof Is Out There

programme.desc: S02 E20 — UFO Eruption and Alien Spheres The truth behind a pattern of UFO sightings near volcanoes; the origin of the strange stone spheres of Costa Rica; the secret of an unidentified man living alone in the jungle.
programme.title: The Proof Is Out There

programme.desc: S02 E22 — Land UFO and Superhuman Strength A UFO spotted over one of the world's holiest sites; a mysterious floating spaceman in a famous photograph; superhumans who can stop cars barehanded.
programme.title: The Proof Is Out There

programme.desc: S02 E24 — UFO Window Seat and Lost Underwater City Sighting of a UFO from the window seat of a passenger jet; a strange underwater discovery is said to be a lost Japanese city; a series of tunnels in Brazil; Tony and team investigate some of the world's strangest photos and videos.
programme.title: The Proof Is Out There

programme.desc: S02 E26 — The Nightcrawler and the Beast in the Tree The team looks into a new sighting of Sasquatch in the trees of California.
programme.title: The Proof Is Out There

programme.desc: S02 E27 — The Creeping Horror and Viral Car Jumpers The truth behind internet videos of acrobats flipping over speeding cars; investigating an amorphous and horrifying crawling creature.
programme.title: The Proof Is Out There

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Visitations Visitations that leave behind objects or witnesses give us fascinating evidence.
programme.title: Encounter: UFO

programme.title: Buried Evidence

programme.title: UFO Chronicles

Both Ben and Josh suffer from cerebral palsy, and after struggling in a multi-level home in Plymouth, and without enough funds to make it disabled friendly, the family have sold up and bought a cheap, old iron forge that, when renovated, will provide single-storey living in the Plymouth countryside.
programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build

programme.desc: Tadej Pogačar hat zum dritten Mal in Folge die Tour de France gewonnen. Für den Slowenen war es insgesamt der fünfte Sieg bei diesem Rennen in seiner Karriere. Den zweiten Platz belegte Remco Evenepoel. Dritter wurde Isaac del Toro. Unter den Franzosen schnitt Paul Seixas am besten ab und erreichte den vierten Platz. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Snooker: WM
programme.desc: Im Finale standen sich der Chinese Wu Yize und der Engländer Shaun Murphy gegenüber. Der 22-jährige chinesische Shootingstar besiegte den Briten in einer Partie voller Wendungen mit 18:17 und wurde damit der zweitjüngste Snooker-Weltmeister der Geschichte. Die Weltmeisterschaft war der abschließende Wettbewerb der Saison 2025/26. (Senderinfo).
